scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good day~
I'm {1}, your
guide to exploring
the Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您好~
我是{1}，
您的艾音布罗克中央塔
探索向导。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Einbroch Tower offers
the best view of our city
and it's a great place to
meet with friends or take
a date. The Einbroch Tower
admission fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾音布罗克中央塔
拥有全城最美的景色，
是和朋友聚会或
约会的绝佳地点。
艾音布罗克中央塔的
门票是10 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, we're offering
a special promotion called
the Apple Combo Set for only
20 zeny. This set includes
Einbroch Tower admission
and an Apple to snack on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前，我们提供
一项名为“苹果套餐”的
特别优惠，仅需20 Zeny。
该套餐包含
艾音布罗克中央塔门票
和一个供您享用的苹果。

scripts.text: Tower Admission Only
scripts.translation: 仅购买门票

scripts.text: Apple Combo Set
scripts.translation: 苹果套餐

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny. The Einbroch
Tower Admission
fee is 10 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
艾音布罗克中央塔的
门票是10 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您使用我们的服务。
请让我立刻带您
前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny. The
Apple Combo Set is 20 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足。
苹果套餐是20 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before I guide you to
the tower, let me check
your status to insure
your safety before I give
you the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在我带您前往中央塔之前，
请让我检查一下您的状态，
以确保您的安全，
然后再给您苹果套餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for
using our services.
Let me guide you to
the tower right away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
感谢您使用我们的服务。
请让我立刻带您
前往中央塔。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sorry, but you're carrying
too many items with you. Please store some of your things in your Kafra Storage before purchasing
the Apple Combo Set.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很抱歉，您携带的物品太多了。
请在购买苹果套餐前，
将部分物品存入卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Feel free to
come back any
time. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。
欢迎随时回来。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
Greetings,
I am Morei,
Assistant Guide
of Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
您好，
我是莫雷，
艾音布罗克中央塔的
助手向导。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
If you wish to return
to the ground floor,
please let me know.
Would you like to go
back to ground level?
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
如果您想返回一楼，
请告诉我。
您想回到一楼吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
Let me lead you
to the ground floor.
Thank you for using
our services.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
明白了。
请让我带您
前往一楼。
感谢您使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Morei]
I see.
I hope you
enjoy your time
in Einbroch Tower.
scripts.translation:
[莫雷]
明白了。
祝您在艾音布罗克中央塔
玩得尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Welcome to
the Train Station.
Trains to Einbech
are always running
so if you miss one,
it's no problem.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
欢迎来到
火车站。
开往艾音贝赫的火车
时刻都在运行，
所以如果您错过了一班，
也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
The fare to board the
train that runs the Einbroch
to Einbech line is 200 zeny.
Would you like to buy a ticket?
scripts.translation:
[职员]
乘坐艾音布罗克至艾音贝赫
线路的火车，
票价是200 Zeny。
您要买票吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: About the Environment...
scripts.translation: 关于环境...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Thank you
very much.
Have a safe trip.
^333333*Ahem*^000000 All aboard!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
非常感谢。
祝您旅途平安。
^333333*咳咳*^000000 各位请上车！

scripts.text:
[Staff]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough zeny
to pay the train fare.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，
无法支付火车票价。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Very well, then.
Please enjoy your
stay in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[职员]
好的。
祝您在艾音布罗克度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Einbroch is infamous for
its air pollution, no doubt
caused by the industrial
facilities located here.
It's really horrible...
scripts.translation:
[职员]
艾音布罗克以空气污染严重而闻名，
这无疑是位于此地的工业设施造成的。
真的很糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Staff]
Sometimes the air pollution
gets so bad that it becomes
hard to breathe. If you hear
the Einbroch Smog Alert, you
should find shelter immediately!
scripts.translation:
[职员]
有时候空气污染严重到让人呼吸困难。
如果您听到艾音布罗克烟雾警报，
请立即寻找避难所！

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
^666666*Cough cough!*^000000
Laaaand sakes!

[Leslie]
An old woman like me
can't breathe this air! How
do people even live in all this
smog? Sure, the air in Einbech
isn't pristine, but the air here in Einbroch is much worse! ^333333*Cough~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
像我这样的老妇人根本呼吸不了这种空气！
人们是怎么在这种烟雾中生活的？
虽然艾音贝赫的空气也不是一尘不染，
但这里的空气要糟糕得多！^333333*咳~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Leslie]
I hate coming here
sometimes! The air is
totally polluted and this
city is full of stuck up
pricks! But they sell stuff
here I can't buy back home...
scripts.translation:
[莱斯利]
我有时候真讨厌来这里！
空气完全被污染了，
这座城市里还全是些傲慢的家伙！
但这里卖的东西，我家乡买不到...

scripts.text:
[Tan]
All the factories
here in Einbroch are
causing a serious air
pollution problem.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
艾音布罗克这里的工厂
造成了严重的空气污染问题。

scripts.text:
[Tan]
I'm an Airship engineer and
everyday, all day long, I deal
with oil stains and all sorts
of pollutants. I'm surprised
I haven't gotten sick yet...
scripts.translation:
[谭]
我是一名飞空艇工程师，
每天整天都要处理油污和各种污染物。
我惊讶自己居然还没生病...

scripts.text:
[Tan]
Still, I try to be careful
when I can. Whenever I go
out into the city's red fog,
I always wear my Flu Mask.
If you'll be here for a while,
you should carry one with you.
scripts.translation:
[谭]
不过，我尽量小心。
每次走出城市进入红色迷雾中，
我都会戴上口罩。
如果您要在这里停留一段时间，
建议您随身携带一个。

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
Excuse me...
But I'm lost!
I can't find my
mom or dad!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
打扰一下...
我迷路了！
我找不到
妈妈或爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
A-am I at the Airport?!
My parents are supposed
to come get me, but I still
haven't found them! We just
moved here, so I don't know
where anything is!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
我...我是不是在飞空艇站？！
我的父母应该来接我，
但我还没找到他们！
我们刚搬到这里，
我什么都不熟悉！

scripts.text:
[Little Toby]
W-wait!
Where are you
going?! Don't leave
me, I'm all alone...!
scripts.translation:
[小 托比]
等...等等！
你要去哪？！
别丢下我，
我一个人好孤单...！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
H-hey! Don't
touch my precious
Burielle! I just finished
her tune-up and now she's
sleeping! J-just step away!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
嘿！别碰
我珍贵的布里埃尔！
我刚给她做完保养，
现在她正在睡觉！
请...请退后！

scripts.text: Who's Burielle?
scripts.translation: 布里埃尔是谁？

scripts.text: Sorry about That.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Burielle is the prettiest
model among all the Airships
made within the last ten years!
She might be grounded now, but
with my healing hands, she'll
conquer the skies again!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
布里埃尔是过去十年里
所有飞空艇中最漂亮的一款！
虽然她现在停飞了，
但凭借我的治愈之手，
她一定会再次征服天空！

scripts.text: Ah~
scripts.translation: 啊~

scripts.text: Uh huh...
scripts.translation: 嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah~
I see, so you're
working on restoring
this magnificent specimen
of an Airship. Best of luck~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊~
原来如此，
您正在修复这艘
宏伟的飞空艇。祝好运~

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Yeah. I'd appreciate
it if you'd just be careful.
I've put a lot of love into
fixing up Burielle...
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
是的。如果你能小心一点，
我会很感激的。
我倾注了很多心血
来修复布里埃尔...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh huh...
Right. For a second
there, I thought you were
talking about a person, but
then I also assumed that you
weren't, you know, a nutcase.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯嗯...
好吧。刚才那一瞬间，我还以为你在说人呢，不过后来我也觉得，你肯定不是那种...怪人吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, did you say,
''prettiest model?''
All Airships look the
same to me, this one
ain't special at all. You've
gone loony tunes, paley boy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你说“最漂亮的型号”？
在我看来，飞空艇都长一个样，这艘也没什么特别的。你脑子坏掉了吧，脸色苍白的小子。

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Wh-what...?!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
什...什么...？！

scripts.text:
[Airship Engineer]
Well, at least you know
what you did wrong. Now
quit disturbing her and git!
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工程师]
哼，至少你知道自己错在哪了。
现在别打扰她，快滚！

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
I've lived here for
a long time and I see
that this huge city is still
growing bigger everyday.
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
我在这里住了很久了，
看着这座巨大的城市
每天都在变得更大。

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
How did Einbroch get so
huge so quickly? I still can't
believe there's been this much
development. Well, I suppose
it's not my concern. Nothing
I do will make a difference...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
艾音布罗克是怎么在这么短的时间内
变得这么大的？我仍然无法相信
会有这么多开发。嗯，我想这也不是
我关心的事。我做什么都改变不了什么...

scripts.text:
[Centzu]
Even though such
rapid industrialization
can't be good for the
environment or the people,
I'll just sit back, watch what
happens and just enjoy life...
scripts.translation:
[岑祖]
虽然这种快速的工业化
对环境或居民来说
可能并不好，
但我还是坐在一旁，
看着发生什么，
然后享受我的生活...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
^666666*Cough cough*^000000
Jiminy! The air here
is so thick and grimy!
And it's worse for us old
people with breathing
problems! ^333333*Haaack!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
^666666*咳咳*^000000
吉米尼！这里的空气
又厚又脏！
对我们这些有呼吸问题
的老人来说更糟！^333333*哈啊！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
I don't care if they keep
building more and more
factories and homes in this
town. Still, I'd like to spend
the rest of my life somewhere
quiet and with clean air...
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
我不管他们是否继续
在这个城镇建造更多的
工厂和住宅。
不过，我想在剩下的生命里
找个安静、空气清新的地方...

scripts.text:
[Khowropher]
Then again, Einbroch is my
hometown and I can't just up
and leave. I suppose it's my
fate to suffer from this foul air until the day I die. ^666666*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[科罗弗]
话虽如此，艾音布罗克是我的家乡，
我不能说走就走。
我想，这就是我的命运，
忍受这污浊的空气直到死去。^666666*叹息...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
Lately, there's been
talk about this empty
building downtown that's
been converted into some
sort of mysterious facility.
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
最近，城里有一栋空房子
被改造成某种
神秘设施，大家都在议论纷纷。

scripts.text:
[Khetine]
It all seems pretty
shady, but I guess it's
not really my job to know
about that. I mean, if it
doesn't affect me, why
should I be concerned?
scripts.translation:
[凯蒂娜]
这一切看起来都很可疑，
但我想这也不是我该管的事。
毕竟，如果不影响我，
我为什么要担心呢？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Surprisingly, we have
a Train Station that everyone
has been calling a victory for
science. I mean, shouldn't we
be more amazed by the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
令人惊讶的是，我们有一个火车站，
大家都把它称为科学的胜利。
我是说，难道我们不应该
对飞空艇感到更惊讶吗？

scripts.text:
[Sleik]
Now, if you want to know
where the train actually goes,
I wouldn't be able to tell you.
After all, I never rode it. But
still, I guess having our own
Train Station is a good thing.
scripts.translation:
[斯莱克]
现在，如果你想知道火车
到底去哪里，
我也无法告诉你。
毕竟，我从来没坐过。但
不管怎样，拥有我们自己的火车站
是一件好事。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
...And that's why
I travel around the
globe. My bosses have
a keen eye for the most
exotic goods, so I acquire
them and make deliveries.
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
...这就是我环游世界的原因。
我的老板们对最稀奇的货物
有着敏锐的眼光，所以我
获取它们并负责运送。

scripts.text:
[Runnan]
There even was a time
when they had me collect
Jellopy, though that stuff is
pretty common nowadays.
Now that I think about it, why
did they need so much stuff?
scripts.translation:
[鲁南]
甚至有一段时间，他们让我
收集杰勒比结晶，虽然这种东西
现在很常见。
现在想想，他们为什么
需要那么多东西？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
Now, I hear that the
monsters around here
carry around some ore
that dazzles with a sublimely
beautiful light. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
现在，我听说这里的魔物
身上带着一些矿石，
它们闪烁着令人惊叹的美丽光芒。
不错吧？

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
These ores are a great
material to use in making
flower vases. My friend, who
happens to be a doll maker,
told me that. He makes these dolls using all sorts of materials.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
这些矿石是制作花瓶的
绝佳材料。我的朋友，
恰好是个玩偶师，告诉我的。
他用各种材料制作这些玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
He fashions them out of
Well-Tanned Leather, stuffs
them with Bird Feathers, and
uses Cyfar or Zargon to make
the eyes. He even uses a Jellopy at the bottom to balance the doll.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
他用鞣制皮革制作，
填充羽毛，
并用赛依伐或刹勒空结晶
制作眼睛。他甚至在底部
使用杰勒比结晶来平衡玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Zhen Lan]
I guess that goes to show
that things that seem useless
might actually be handy in some
way. So don't worry about having too much stuff. Sooner or later, it might be useful to someone.
scripts.translation:
[真岚]
我想，这说明看似无用的东西
实际上可能在某些方面很有用。
所以，不要担心拥有太多东西。
迟早，它可能对某人有用。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you just pay me money,
I'll be your slave! There's
nothing I won't do! Anything
is fair game. Hell, I'll get buck naked if you pay me enough.
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要你给我钱，
我就做你的奴隶！
没有什么是我做不到的！
什么都可以商量。
要是钱给得够多，
我甚至愿意裸体伺候你。

scripts.text:
[Teinz]
If you pay me what I'm
worth, I'll work hard at
any task you set me to.
Sure, mining's rough, but
as long as the zeny's coming
in, I'm happy. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[泰因茨]
只要你付给我应得的报酬，
我就会努力完成你交代的任何任务。
没错，挖矿很辛苦，
但只要Zeny源源不断，
我就很开心。嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Hey. Why are you
looking at me like
that? There's no idle
chatting allowed at work.
If Canphotii catches
you, you'll be punished...
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
喂。你为什么要那样看着我？
工作时是不允许闲聊的。
要是被坎福蒂抓到，
你会受罚的...

scripts.text:
[Lowe]
Oh wait...
You don't work here.
I apologize, that kind
of reaction's an old
habit for me, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[洛威]
啊，等等...
你并不在这里工作。
抱歉，这种反应是我的老习惯了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Do you know why a woman
like me has to work in this
factory? I'll tell you why...
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
你知道像我这样的女人，
为什么要在工厂里工作吗？
我来告诉你原因...

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
My lazy husband, Gesin,
is just lying there on the
ground! So I have to work
in order to support us!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
我那懒散的丈夫格辛，
就那样躺在地上！
所以我必须工作来养家！

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
We can't rest for even
a second if we want to save
enough money to become
wealthy and powerful some
day. Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
如果我们想攒够钱，
有朝一日变得富有且强大，
我们就一刻也不能休息。
你不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Dinje]
Well, my husband obviously
doesn't! How can he not know
how the real world works?!
Hey, kick his ass for me if
he doesn't wake up soon!
scripts.translation:
[丁杰]
嗯，我丈夫显然不明白！
他怎么不知道现实世界是怎么运作的？！
嘿，如果他还不醒来，
你就替我揍他一顿！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
There was a time
when I dreamed of
being an adventurer,
just like you. But that
was a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
曾经有一段时间，
我也梦想着像你一样，
成为一名冒险者。
但那已经是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Now, I'm nothing but
a factory manager. Still,
even if my job's not that
great, I'm pretty satisfied.
I'm sure people enjoy the
products I oversee and all...
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
现在，我不过是个工厂管理员。
不过，即使这份工作不算出色，
我也挺满意的。
我相信人们都很喜欢我负责的产品...

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
Maybe my life was meant
to be this way, even if it's
not how I planned it. But the
time will come when I up and
leave and travel the world
once I get my chance!
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
也许我的命运就是如此，
尽管这并不是我原本的计划。
但总有一天，
当我有机会时，
我会离开这里，去环游世界！

scripts.text:
[Tsuen]
I hope the day will
come when I can meet
you out in that big wide
world and greet you as
a fellow adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[翠恩]
我希望有一天，
我能在广阔的世界中遇见你，
并以同行冒险者的身份向你问好。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Arrrgh!
This is killing me!
Why should I be rich?
What's wrong with living
within our means?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
啊！
这太折磨人了！
我为什么要变富有？
量入为出有什么不好？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
I've got no problem
with my current way
of life, but the old ball
and chain disagrees.
Why is she so obsessed
with riches and power?
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
我对目前的生活方式没有任何问题，
但那个老女人却不同意。
她为什么对财富和权力如此痴迷？

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
Well, in any case, I'd
like to help her, but I can't
get up! I'm exhausted and
my body is just overtaxed.
I have no strength at all.
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
总之，我想帮她，
但我起不来！
我精疲力竭，身体已经超负荷了。
我一点力气都没有。

scripts.text:
[Gesin]
This is horrible~
I should be resting
instead of worrying
about making money...
scripts.translation:
[格辛]
这太糟糕了~
我应该休息，
而不是担心赚钱...

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Good god!
I'm so stressed!
It's been nonstop
since I moved here!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
天哪！
压力好大！
自从搬到这里以来，
就没停过！

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
The work is tough and
already the boss hates
me! I didn't move here
for this! Still, the pay is
decent so I guess I should
endure just a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
工作很艰难，
而且老板已经讨厌我了！
我搬到这里可不是为了这个！
不过，薪水还算不错，
我想我还是再坚持一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Pevtatin]
Here goes...!
Yo-heave-ho!
Yo-heave-ho~!
scripts.translation:
[佩夫塔廷]
开始干活了...！
嘿咻——嘿咻！
嘿咻——嘿咻~！

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
It's great that the
factory is making good
business and drawing
in a lot of profit, but I still
have one major concern.
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
工厂生意兴隆，利润丰厚，这固然很好，但我仍有一个重大的担忧。

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
The amount of pollution
that this place is causing
is horrific! We've got these
machines blowing out toxic
gas all day long! The air
can't be safe for very long...
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
这里造成的污染触目惊心！这些机器整天都在排放有毒气体！空气恐怕很快就会变得不安全了...

scripts.text:
[Rombell]
I mean, the air we're
breathing right now is
pretty foul and things
are only going to get
worse. How can we
solve this problem?
scripts.translation:
[罗姆贝尔]
我的意思是，我们现在呼吸的空气已经很难闻了，而且情况只会越来越糟。我们该如何解决这个问题呢？

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Staring at this
bubbling hot liquid
metal gives me a good
feeling inside. It's like
that stuff can melt anything!
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
盯着这沸腾的液态金属，让我心里感到一阵舒坦。这东西好像能融化一切！

scripts.text:
[Vonstein]
Imagine covering an
entire street of people
with that stuff! Bwahah--
Oh, I'm sorry if I'm talking
crazy talk! I'm just kidding~
scripts.translation:
[冯斯坦]
想象一下，用这东西覆盖整条街道的人群！哇哈哈——
啊，抱歉，我是不是说胡话了？我只是开个玩笑~

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Machines are sooo
convenient. Just look
at this contraption easily
do tasks that'd be tough
for me to finish alone.
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
机器真是太方便了。看看这个装置，轻松就能完成我独自难以完成的任务。

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
Now this is what
I call technology!
Sure, it takes effort and
money to make one of
these, but what do I care?
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
这才叫科技！
虽然制造这些需要花费精力和金钱，但我才不在乎呢。

scripts.text:
[Dorf]
I've got no problems,
so long as this freaking
thing keeps working the
way I want it to!
scripts.translation:
[多夫]
只要这个该死的东西能按我的意愿运转，我就没有任何问题！

scripts.text:
[Khashurantze]
I'm sorry, but you need
special authority in order
to enter this place. I'll have
to ask you to leave right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡舒兰策]
很抱歉，进入此地需要特殊权限。请您立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
I'm in charge of this
blast furnace which
contains all of this
boiling magma.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
我负责管理这座高炉，里面装满了沸腾的岩浆。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Even though it doesn't
require actual labor, this
job is pretty tiring. I've got
to pay careful attention all
the time. It's pretty stressful.
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
虽然不需要实际体力劳动，但这工作相当累人。我必须时刻高度集中注意力，压力很大。

scripts.text:
[Zherin]
Still, I'm proud of my job
since I have the responsibility
of ensuring employee safety.
Anyway, don't get too close
to the furnace. It won't do if
you get burned on accident!
scripts.translation:
[泽林]
不过，我为自己的工作感到自豪，因为我肩负着确保员工安全的责任。总之，请不要靠炉子太近。万一不小心被烧伤就麻烦了！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Hustle, hustle!
Pick up the pace!
Anyone working too
slowly will be punished!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
快点，快点！
加快速度！
工作太慢的人会受到惩罚！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
Can't you understand
that?! Now go to your
station and get back to
work! Wait, are you even
an employee? If not, then
stop wandering around!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你难道不明白吗？！现在回到你的岗位上去工作！等等，你甚至是员工吗？如果不是，那就别在这里闲逛！

scripts.text:
[Canphotii]
You're not supposed
to be able to get in here!
I can't believe they let you
in! This requires extreme
disciplinary action!
scripts.translation:
[坎福蒂]
你不应该能进到这里来！
我真不敢相信他们让你进来了！
这需要采取严厉的纪律处分！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
This factory has a lot
of things that need fixing,
pronto! I'm amazed that
the place is still operating!
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
这家工厂有很多东西需要尽快修复！
真不敢相信这里居然还能运转！

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
Lucky for us, I hear that
some altruistic adventurers
have been donating materials
to help keep this factory from
falling apart... Or worse.
But that's just a rumor.
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
幸运的是，我听说
有一些乐于助人的冒险者
一直在捐赠材料，
帮助这家工厂免于彻底崩塌...或者更糟。
不过那只是传闻。

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
Even if it is true,
there's nothing no one
here can do. Nobody has
the courage to challenge
the system, you know?
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
^666666*叹气*^000000
即使那是真的，
这里也没有人能做些什么。
毕竟没有人有勇气去挑战体制，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Cendadt]
I...
I better get
back to work
before I get
in trouble...
scripts.translation:
[岑达特]
我...
我得赶紧回去工作，
不然要惹麻烦了...
